svg.title: Contention concentrates on the best seats
svg.desc: Three seat blocks in front of a stage. The front-centre block is mostly held or booked while side blocks are mostly available. Each block is one inventory shard. Illustrative only.

g.text: Demand is not spread evenly across the venue.
Illustrative. Splitting inventory by section spreads load, but the most wanted section can still be one hot shard.
